title: Fix branding and role-based post-login routing for Saddam Chat

requirements.text: Replace all user-facing occurrences of the string "Admin Portal" with "Saddam Chat" across the frontend, including (at minimum) the app header, screen titles/headings, and the HTML document title/meta in frontend/index.html.

quotes: Replace all occurrences of "Admin Portal" with the app name "Saddam Chat" (header, titles, meta).

acceptanceCriteria: AppHeader no longer renders "Admin Portal" and instead renders "Saddam Chat".
Login screen heading no longer renders "Admin Portal" and instead renders "Saddam Chat".
frontend/index.html <title> is set to "Saddam Chat" (fix any typos) and the browser tab shows "Saddam Chat".
No remaining visible UI text shows "Admin Portal" anywhere in the app.

requirements.text: Update post-login redirect logic so that after a successful login: super_admin redirects to /chat by default; admin redirects to /chat; approved non-admin users redirect to /chat; only unapproved non-admin users redirect to /pending-approval. Ensure admin/super_admin never get sent to the Pending Approval screen due to an approval flag check order.

quotes:
Change post-login routing:
   - super_admin → redirect to /chat by default
   - admin → redirect to /chat
   - normal approved user → /chat
   - only unapproved users → Pending Approval screen

acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with role=super_admin always navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=admin always navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=user and approved=true navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=user and approved=false navigates to /pending-approval.
No admin/super_admin account can end up on /pending-approval as a result of the login redirect logic.

requirements.text: Ensure the User Management screen at route /admin/users is accessible from the Chat experience via the header dropdown menu for super_admin users (i.e., from the Chat screen header menu, super_admin can navigate to /admin/users).

quotes: Make User Management (/admin/users) accessible from Chat via header menu for super_admin.

acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as super_admin and viewing /chat, the header profile dropdown includes a "User Management" item.
Clicking "User Management" from /chat navigates to /admin/users successfully.
When signed in as non-super-admin, the "User Management" menu item is not shown.

requirements.text: Remove any routing/guard behavior that blocks super_admin or admin users behind dashboard-only screens (e.g., do not force admins to land on /admin or require visiting /admin before accessing other allowed routes). Admin and super_admin should be able to access /chat and other non-authenticated routes permitted by login without being redirected to dashboard-only pages.

quotes: Do NOT block super_admin or admin on dashboard-only screens.

acceptanceCriteria: After login, admin and super_admin are not redirected to /admin or any dashboard-only route unless they explicitly navigate there.
If an admin/super_admin manually navigates to /chat, they are allowed to stay on /chat (no automatic redirect to admin dashboard screens).

requirements.text: Ensure super_admin always has access to the user list (/admin/users) without being routed through or blocked by the approval flow (Pending Approval). Any approval gating must apply only to non-admin users.

quotes: Ensure super_admin always sees user list access without needing approval flow.

acceptanceCriteria: A super_admin with an unapproved flag (if present in their profile data) is still able to navigate to /admin/users and view the user list screen.
A super_admin is never redirected to /pending-approval when attempting to access /admin/users.
Only non-admin users who are unapproved are shown /pending-approval.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify immutable hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose around them instead).
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor (no new backend services).
nonGoals: Implementing actual chat functionality beyond existing placeholder UI.
Adding new authentication providers or changing the auth system beyond the specified routing/menu/branding fixes.
Redesigning the admin area information architecture beyond enabling the specified access paths.

preferencesToAdd: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.
